Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey,
Advocate for the respondent.
2. The present Criminal Revision has
been preferred by the revisionist, assailing
the order dated 08.04.2025 passed by the
learned Principal Judge, Family Court,
Haridwar in Case No.18 of 2024, whereby
the application moved by the respondent
under Section 125 Cr.P.C. was allowed
and the revisionist was directed to pay a
sum of ₹5,000/- per month to the
respondent towards interim maintenance
with effect from the date of filing of the
said application.
3. Today, the parties are personally
present before this Court. With a view to
explore the possibility of an amicable
settlement, the parties were referred to
mediation. The Mediator has submitted
his report, which is available on record. A
perusal of the said report indicates that
joint as well as individual sessions were
held with the parties and, during the
course of mediation, the parties have
arrived at an amicable settlement of their

UKHC010054812026
2026:UHC:9002
dispute. The mediation proceedings have,
accordingly, been concluded successfully.
The terms and conditions of the
settlement/agreement arrived at between
the parties have been duly reduced into
writing and are annexed with the
Mediator's report.
4. The parties, being present before the
Court, have also acknowledged the
settlement arrived at between them and
have expressed their willingness to abide
by the terms and conditions contained
therein. The settlement appears to have
been arrived at voluntarily and without
any apparent coercion or undue influence.
5. In view of the amicable settlement
arrived at between the parties, as duly
reflected in the settlement agreement
annexed with the Mediator's report, no
useful purpose would be served in
permitting the impugned order to remain
in operation. Consequently, the present
Criminal Revision is allowed. The order
dated 08.04.2025 passed by learned
Principal Judge, Family Court, Haridwar
in Case No.18 of 2024 is hereby set aside.
6. The settlement/agreement arrived at
between the parties, annexed with the
Mediator's report, shall form part of this
order and the parties shall remain bound
by the terms and conditions thereof.
